title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale
abstract: arXiv:2609.15939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly operate over complete software repositories, yet cybersecurity evaluations primarily measure whether they can detect, reproduce, or repair vulnerabilities rather than whether they can locate the relevant code. We study vulnerability localization: given a weakness class and an unfamiliar repository, identify the implementation files associated with that weakness. We introduce the Vulnerability Localization Benchmark (VLoc Bench), comprising 500 real world vulnerabilities from 290 repositories across six package ecosystems and 147 CWE categories. Each task pairs repository snapshots immediately before and after a security fix. On the vulnerable snapshot, an agent receives only the CWE description and read-only terminal access and must return the affected files; on the patched snapshot, it must determine that the recorded vulnerability is no longer present. translated_title: 漏洞定位基准：在仓库规模上衡量智能体安全分析能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15939v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：语言模型智能体越来越多地在完整的软件仓库上运行，然而网络安全评估主要衡量它们能否检测、复现或修复漏洞，而非衡量它们能否定位相关代码。我们研究漏洞定位问题：给定一个弱点类别和一个陌生仓库，识别与该弱点相关的实现文件。我们提出了漏洞定位基准，包含来自六个软件包生态系统中290个仓库的500个真实世界漏洞，涵盖147个CWE类别。每个任务将安全修复前后的仓库快照进行配对。在漏洞快照上，智能体仅获得CWE描述和只读终端访问权限，必须返回受影响的文件；在修补后的快照上，它必须确定已记录的漏洞不再存在。我们评估了27个语言模型和四个静态分析工具（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了VLoc Bench——一个涵盖6个软件包生态系统中290个仓库的500个真实漏洞、跨越147个CWE类别的漏洞定位基准，通过前后修复快照配对的任务设计，系统评估语言模型智能体在仓库规模上定位安全漏洞相关代码的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces VLoc Bench, a vulnerability localization benchmark comprising 500 real-world vulnerabilities from 290 repositories across six package ecosystems and 147 CWE categories, which uses paired pre- and post-fix repository snapshots to systematically evaluate language-model agents' ability to locate security-vulnerable code at repository scale.
